title: Tiny, cute submarine
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water hint -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='20' r='3' fill='#3fb8d8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='16' r='2' fill='#3fb8d8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='12' r='2.5' fill='#3fb8d8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='80' r='2.5' fill='#3fb8d8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='62' r='2' fill='#3fb8d8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- body hull -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='36' ry='21' fill='#f2c53d'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='34' ry='15' fill='#ffd95e'/>
  <!-- belly stripe -->
  <path d='M20 62 Q50 74 80 62 L78 66 Q50 78 22 66 Z' fill='#e0a92a'/>
  <!-- dome / conning tower -->
  <path d='M38 34 Q38 22 50 22 Q62 22 62 34 Z' fill='#f2c53d'/>
  <path d='M41 33 Q41 25 50 25 Q59 25 59 33 Z' fill='#ffd95e'/>

  <rect x='48.5' y='10' width='3' height='14' rx='1.4' fill='#d8dce6'/>
  <rect x='48.5' y='10' width='3' height='14' rx='1.4' fill='#b9c0cf' opacity='0.5'/>
  <rect x='51' y='11' width='6' height='3' rx='1.4' fill='#b9c0cf'/>
  <!-- portholes -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='50' r='6' fill='#3fb8d8'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='50' r='4' fill='#8fe3f5'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='48.5' r='1.4' fill='#e8fbff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='50' r='6' fill='#3fb8d8'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='50' r='4' fill='#8fe3f5'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='48.5' r='1.4' fill='#e8fbff'/>
  <!-- face porthole: eyes -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='42' r='2.2' fill='#243763'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='42' r='2.2' fill='#243763'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='46' r='1.8' fill='#ff8f7a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='46' r='1.8' fill='#ff8f7a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 47 Q50 50 54 47' stroke='#243763' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- propeller fin -->
  <rect x='82' y='46' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#d8dce6'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='52' r='5' fill='#b9c0cf'/>
  <path d='M88 47 Q92 52 88 57 Q84 52 88 47 Z' fill='#f2c53d'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='52' r='1.6' fill='#ffd95e'/>
</svg>
